title: Spec Manifest
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for spec.yaml sidecar — the machine-readable manifest for a spec concept directory.

id.description: Concept identifier. Must be C- followed by an uppercase letter and then uppercase letters, digits, or hyphens.

summary.description: One-line summary of the concept (mandatory; 1–180 characters).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this spec concept.

owner_team.description: Team responsible for this concept. Non-empty when present; omit entirely when unknown.

views.description: Ordered list of view documents for this concept.

type.description: View category. Core types: overview, data-model, flows, api, constraints, scenarios, cases. Project-declared types must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ and be declared in view_types.

file.description: File path relative to the concept directory.

view_types.description: Project-declared view type extensions (ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 style). Each entry declares a custom type name alongside the stakeholder concern it frames and a one-line description of what the view contains.

name.description: Type name. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ and must not collide with a core type.

concern.description: Which stakeholder question or architectural concern this view frames.

contents.description: One-line description of what this document contains.

language.description: Source language for type declarations. Only 'typescript' is currently supported; other values cause the check to be skipped with an informational message.

scan_root.description: Directory to scan for type declarations, relative to the project root. Defaults to 'src'.

status_policy.description: Custom status transition rules. Keys are status values; values are freeform policy strings.
